adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that Office365CalendarService.createEvent and LarkCalendarService.createEvent don't accept the credentialId parameter that was added to the Calendar interface (packages/types/Calendar.d.ts line 221 shows `createEvent(event: CalendarEvent, credentialId: number)`). GoogleCalendarService was updated to accept credentialId (line 87), but Office365 (line 72) and Lark (line 125) still have the old signature. This means for collective team bookings where multiple calendars need events created, these services cannot properly match the credential to the correct destination calendar, potentially causing events to be created in wrong calendars or fail entirely.
